pages.text:
The Air Separator pulls in air and separates it into Nitrogen and Oxygen with FE. It needs no input: every 2 s it makes 80 mB of Nitrogen and 20 mB of Oxygen, at 80 FE/t.
- It works anywhere except the End, which has no air to separate.
- Oxygen leaves through Oxygen faces (the left, by default) and Nitrogen through Gas Output faces (the right). Pipe them away with Pressurized Conduits.
- When one tank is full, what doesn't fit goes back into the air, so it keeps making the other. It only stops when both are full.
# Why
- Nitrogen goes into the Haber Reactor to make Ammonia.
- Oxygen is a second source besides the Electrolyzer, for oxy-fuel and the Arcforge Furnace, with no hydrogen to deal with. One Air Separator keeps two oxy-fuel burners going.
Speed and Energy upgrades work.
